title: Python Clipboard Viewer in 3 Steps

steps.title: Step 1: Setup
steps.explanation: We start by importing the necessary libraries: pyperclip for clipboard access and tkinter for the GUI.

steps.title: Step 2: Create Window
steps.explanation: We create a hidden tkinter window to avoid showing an empty GUI window to the user.

steps.title: Step 3: Show Clipboard Content
steps.explanation: We attempt to retrieve and show the clipboard content. If there's an error, we display it instead.

steps.title: Step 4: Run and See
code_lines: # Run the script to see your clipboard content!
steps.explanation: That's it! Run the code and see what's on your clipboard in a pop-up window.

intro_hook: Ever want to see what's on your clipboard? Let's make it happen!
